topSignals.title: BE rebounds to $202 on August 1 — market digests Q2 blowout
topSignals.text: — After hitting $159.80 intraday on July 31, Bloom Energy has recovered to $202.08 (−1.81% on the day) on August 1. The recovery confirms the post-earnings profit-taking wave is exhausting. Q2 2026 headline numbers: revenue $1.065B (+166% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $0.78 (vs. $0.40 consensus), FY2026 guidance raised to $3.9–4.2B revenue / $800–900M operating income / EPS $2.55–2.85. Brookfield project framework expanded from $5B to $25B. All major U.S. hyperscalers plus 12+ neoclouds/AI labs validated Bloom systems. BusinessWire Q2 PR | BigGo Q2 summary

topSignals.title: FERC RM26-4: ISO-NE confirms August 3 abeyance intent — model trigger in 48 hours
topSignals.text: — ISO New England and its transmission owners have formally confirmed (ISO Newswire) they will file a 90-day abeyance request by the August 3 deadline. If granted: ISO-NE (and by precedent PJM, MISO, CAISO) gets until November 16 to file tariff reforms — deferring the $5–20/MWh avoided-T-cost SOFC LCOE input for all non-ERCOT scenarios. If denied: August 17 hard deadline forces immediate reform filing, opening the avoided-T-cost input within weeks. Schedule a model update pass for August 4. ISO Newswire | FERC RM26-4

topSignals.title: Bloom 2026 Data Center Power Report: 32% of US data centers plan fully off-grid SOFC by 2030
topSignals.text: — Bloom Energy's 2026 Data Center Power Report (double-blind survey, 152 industry insiders) finds nearly one-third of U.S. data centers intend to run fully on on-site SOFCs by 2030. Separately, up to half of all large AI data center projects scheduled for 2026 are now delayed or canceled due to power constraints — increasing pull toward 90-day SOFC deployments. First data-backed demand-side penetration forecast for the DC segment. enkiai.com citing Bloom report | Private grid analysis

items.text: Elcogen: No new announcements August 1. EFCF 2026 (Lucerne, June 30–July 3) papers remain in journal peer review — embargo now exceeds 4 weeks. ELCO I Tallinn factory (360 MW/yr) in volume production; E3000 G2 deliveries continuing. Watch elcogen.com for embargo lift. Status: no change.

Topsoe: No new SOFC/SOEC announcements. Herning SOEC factory hibernated (strategy adjustment confirmed May 2026); new CEO Elena Scaltritti (since June 1, 2026). Latest company news: Jordan green ammonia FEED and Sasol eSAF licensing (July 14). SOFC data-center pathway deferred to 2029+ per H2 market constraints. Topsoe May pathway adjustment

Bloom Energy: Q2 2026 call confirmed 2 GW/yr Fremont ramp "on track for end-2026." Brookfield project framework expansion ($5B → $25B) materially increases financing available for future SOFC data-center deployments. All major U.S. hyperscalers plus 12+ neoclouds/AI labs/colocation operators validated Bloom systems for AI facilities.
Ceres Power: First royalties received from licensees (commercial-scale partner manufacturing now active — structural milestone). No new August 1 news. H1 2026 results (September) next catalyst.

32% of US data centers targeting off-grid SOFC by 2030 (Top Signal #3): Bloom's 2026 DC Power Report is the first primary-source demand-side forecast specifically quantifying SOFC market penetration in the data center sector.

Ratepayer Protection Pledge (March 2026, new to this digest): Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Oracle, and xAI signed a White House-facilitated agreement to directly fund all necessary grid infrastructure improvements. This decouples hyperscaler data center construction from ratepayer cost exposure and reduces political risk for large-load interconnection reform — structurally supportive of on-site/islanded SOFC deployments. Avanza Energy Substack

Project Jupiter (NM): No August 1 developments. Status unchanged: two natural gas pipeline rejections by NM Land Commissioner; NM senators opposing air permits; air permit public hearing October 19 (Sunland Park Multi-Generational Center); NM AG criminal investigation ongoing. SemiAnalysis 2029 first-power base case unchanged. Source NM air permit hearing

FERC RM26-4 abeyance (48 hours to deadline): See Top Signal #2. ISO-NE abeyance filing expected August 3. If granted: avoided-T-cost modeling deferred to Q4 2026. If denied: August 17 hard deadline triggers immediate RTO tariff reform filings. ISO Newswire
Quiet day otherwise. NY moratorium (50 MW+ threshold, islanded exemption), EU CADA, German EnEfG (PUE ≤1.2 / ERF ≥10% / 15% waste heat reuse from July 2026): no changes from July 31 digest.

Quiet day. Background benchmarks unchanged: CCGT $2,000–2,200/kW capex, SMRs realistically 2030+ (NRC Part 53 framework delays; licensing timelines unchanged), solar+storage $25/MWh LCOE (unsuitable for 24/7 baseload AI workloads). No new hyperscaler nuclear/SMR deals announced August 1.

Bloom Energy (BE): $202.08 (−1.81%) August 1 — recovery from $159.80 July 31 intraday. Previous session closed ~$205. Full analyst PT landscape: consensus $273–286 (29 analysts; 8+ Strong Buy, 16 Hold, 1 Strong Sell). All PTs above current price. Recent changes: JPMorgan $346 → $314 (Hold, July 28); UBS $350 → $300 (Buy, July 30); Wells Fargo $217 → $176 (July 28); Mizuho Neutral → Outperform $242 (July 30); Clear Street Hold → Buy $290 (July 28). BusinessWire | Yahoo Finance

FuelCell Energy (FCEL): No new August 1 news. Recent context: Q2 FY2026 revenue $35.6M (−4.9% YoY), operating loss $77.9M; $225M equity offering (July 7-8); ~$23 range after +29% sympathy rally July 30. YTD +192%. Next catalyst: Q3 FY2026 earnings (October). CNBC FCEL
Ceres Power (LON: CWR): Quiet. ~−40% from June peak. H1 2026 results (September) next catalyst.

"Toward high-efficiency solid oxide fuel cells: A comprehensive review of hybrid integration techniques" (Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews, ScienceDirect, 2026) — Standalone SOFC: 50–60% electrical efficiency; SOFC-GT/CHP/trigeneration hybrid: >85% total system efficiency. Covers SOFC-gas turbine, combined heat and power, double hybrid cycles, trigeneration, and SOFC-battery architectures. System-architecture reference for data-center CHP integration. LCOE flag. ScienceDirect

"Techno-economic and environmental analysis of hybrid SOFC-GT-sCO2 systems for sustainable energy generation" (ScienceDirect, 2026) — TEA and environmental LCA of SOFC combined with gas turbine and supercritical CO2 Brayton bottoming cycle. New cost and efficiency benchmarks for high-efficiency hybrid architectures directly relevant to CHP data-center modeling. LCOE flag. ScienceDirect

"Toward high-efficiency solid oxide fuel cells: A comprehensive review of hybrid integration techniques" (RSER, 2026) — System-level hybrid integration survey: standalone SOFC 50–60% electrical efficiency; with GT/CHP/trigeneration integration: >85% total efficiency. For LCOE modeling: CHP heat recovery at $20–40/MWh value reduces effective LCOE by $15–25/MWh. Separate standalone and CHP scenarios justified. LCOE flag. ScienceDirect

"Techno-economic and environmental analysis of hybrid SOFC-GT-sCO2 systems" (ScienceDirect, 2026) — System-level TEA: SOFC with gas turbine and sCO2 bottoming cycle. New efficiency and cost benchmarks for advanced hybrid systems. Directly actionable for LCOE model CHP/hybrid scenario parameterization. LCOE flag. ScienceDirect

No other new system-level SOFC papers identified for August 1. Prior active references: creep damage (PMC12942563), air-supply degradation (PMC12806198), EPFL Nat. Commun. 17:2421 (66.3% efficiency), RSC Green Chemistry CHP TEA, SOFC-GT-SE multi-objective (Energy 345, 2026).

lcoe.text: BE stock recovery ($202 vs. $159.80 July 31 intraday): If BE holds above $200 through week end, revise WACC sensitivity band downward: walk back from 10.5–11% to 10–10.5%. Recovery to pre-earnings range suggests institutional confidence in Q2 fundamentals — panic floor is likely in.

Bloom Q2 2026 guidance — implied H2 shipment rate: FY2026 guidance midpoint $4.05B vs. H1 revenue ~$1.79B ($751M Q1 + $1.065B Q2 → ~$1.82B) implies H2 revenue ~$2.2B. At ~33% gross margin and ~$1,600/kW ASP (directional), H2 shipments ~1,375 MW → ~688 MW/quarter. Approaches the 2 GW/yr nameplate run-rate. Action: When Bloom files 10-Q (within 45 days of July 28), extract actual shipped MW and update capex/revenue-per-kW inputs.

Hybrid integration efficiency (new RSER 2026 review): Standalone SOFC: 50–60% LHV; SOFC-GT/CHP: >85% total. Add a CHP scenario in LCOE model: heat recovery credit at $20–40/MWh reduces effective electricity LCOE by $15–25/MWh. Particularly relevant for AI data centers with significant cooling/thermal load.

FERC RM26-4 avoided-T-cost trigger (Aug 4): Update SOFC LCOE competitiveness vs. grid in PJM/MISO/CAISO/ISO-NE after FERC's August 3 response. If abeyance denied: activate $5–20/MWh avoided-T-cost as live model input.
Pending (carry-forward): Bloom 10-Q for explicit shipped MW in Q2. Stack replacement interval update pending SOFC creep damage paper (PMC12942563) full read.
